canonical_space.definition: Aligned Visible Human Female image frame of the Denver 2022 release (Andreassen et al. 2022): +x subject right, +y anterior, +z superior, millimetres.

image_to_stage.review_status: empirical-axis-check; defines canonical space VHF-image-2022 (transforms/canonical-space.json); anatomical-review-pending

canonical_space.status: defined from the Denver aligned image frame; verified against the NLM VHF CT header frame by a rigid same-donor pelvis fit (rotation 2.17 deg, free scale 1.0013, pelvis p95 4.7 mm)

nlm_verification.interpretation: The Denver aligned image frame and the NLM CT header frame agree in axis directions and millimetre units: the rigid pelvis fit needs a small rotation and a scale of 1 within one percent, and the same-donor pelvis surfaces agree to a few millimetres. The translation absorbs the different origins (vertex plane of the CT versus the Denver image origin). This verifies the canonical space against NLM image data; it does not review the anatomy of either segmentation.

registered_sources.hra-female: hra-stage-to-vhf (organ proxies onto same-donor CT organs, experimental)
registered_sources.tcia: tcia003-stage-to-vhf (pelvic landmark similarity, experimental; alternative source, not composed)

transforms.landmark_selection: bounding-box centres of six organ/pelvis proxies (targets: NLM VHF CT labels of the Denver donor)
limitations: Bounding-box centres are geometric proxies, not anatomical landmarks.
HRA is a multi-donor reference assembly; organ placement inside the VHF trunk is unreviewed.
Targets are automatic CT labels (TotalSegmentator) of the VHF donor, not reviewed organ surfaces.

cross_checks.landmark_selection: pelvic: anterior_superior_iliac_spine, iliac_crest_apex, ischial_tuberosity, pubic_symphysis_facet, femoral_head_centre

landmark_provenance.method: automatic geometric rules on optimized viewer meshes (scripts/extract-landmarks.py)

cross_checks.interpretation: HRA pelvic landmarks fit the Denver pelvis closely (the HRA VH_F skeleton derives from the Visible Human Female), but the direct pelvic fit places HRA trunk organs away from the same-donor CT organs by the offsets listed; the organ-proxy fit is used for the composite.

regional_transforms.type: similarity-bounding-box-fit into the NLM VHF CT brain envelope
limitations: Brain bounding-box containment is not a surface registration or anatomical validation.
The same transform is applied to cranial sensory structures; their placement and cervical continuity are unreviewed.

transforms.type: identity (the NLM CT source atlas is already expressed in the canonical stage through nlm-ct-to-vhf)

components.type: rigid (ICP, no scale) on the pelvis: CT hip bones and sacrum onto Denver hip bones and sacrum
components.review_status: automatic same-donor surface registration; anatomy unreviewed
components.segment_scope: trunk, pelvis and head (rigid with the pelvis); femora need their own rigid fits (pose_change_relative_to_pelvis)

fit.purpose: Pose check: one similarity over pelvis, knee and ankle landmarks.

pose_check.interpretation: Knee and ankle residuals of 50-80 mm under one similarity indicate a different lower-limb pose (TCIA 003 knees flexed, shank inclined), not a frame error.

limitations: Landmarks are automatic geometric rules on grouped CT labels split by connected components or midline sign; no anatomist has confirmed them.
Different donors (VHF, 59 years; TCIA 003, 26 years, 1.70 m) and poses; a similarity cannot remove pose differences.
Since composition 0.4 the composite uses the same-donor NLM CT instead of TCIA 003; this fit only positions the alternative source.
